strings.name: Zhang Yimou
strings.summary: Zhang moved from cinematography to directing as a member of China’s Fifth Generation. Red Sorghum, Raise the Red Lantern and To Live gained international attention for color and individual fates. He later made commercial epics including Hero and directed Beijing’s summer and winter Olympic ceremonies. In 2014 he and his wife were fined for violating the then birth policy.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He directed Red Sorghum, To Live and other films and participated in major cultural performances, advancing the international circulation of Chinese visual storytelling.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Xi’an, Shaanxi, China. Sources disagree between 1950 and 1951, with conflicting birth dates.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Entered Beijing Film Academy’s cinematography department in 1978 and graduated in 1982.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Filmmaking
strings.highlights.h1.text: Red Sorghum, To Live and other films explore color, rural life and individual fates.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Olympic ceremonies
strings.highlights.h2.text: Chief director of Beijing’s 2008 and 2022 Olympic opening and closing ceremonies, working with large teams.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Scare Out
strings.timeline.t1.text: His Scare Out opened, portraying contemporary counterespionage.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Beijing Winter Olympics
strings.timeline.t2.text: Served as chief director of that Games’ opening and closing ceremonies with a large team.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Birth-policy fine
strings.timeline.t3.text: He and Chen Ting were fined about 7.49 million yuan by Wuxi authorities under the then birth policy.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Beijing Summer Olympics
strings.timeline.t4.text: Served as chief director of that Games’ opening and closing ceremonies with a large team.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Hero
strings.timeline.t5.text: Directed this film, developing his exploration of genre cinema.
strings.timeline.t6.title: To Live
strings.timeline.t6.text: Directed this film, developing his exploration of genre cinema.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Red Sorghum — Golden Bear
strings.timeline.t7.text: His directing debut Red Sorghum won Berlin’s Golden Bear.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Film-academy graduation
strings.timeline.t8.text: After graduating, joined Guangxi Film Studio as a cinematographer.
